title: PROMO-03 — product-visual-assembler.ts: FFmpeg Ken Burns animation + split-screen compositor
rationale: TICKET-008 P1-PROMO Sprint 3/5. Animates product images with FFmpeg zoompan (Ken Burns). Split-screen: 60% avatar left / 40% product right for image beats; full-width for null-image beats. Per-beat segments then xfade concat. Output 1080x1920 vertical MP4. Gate: 45-65s MP4, Ken Burns visible, layout correct per beat map.

tasks.description: Create scripts/promo/product-visual-assembler.ts — downloads product images, builds per-beat MP4 segments (Ken Burns via zoompan, split-screen via hstack), xfade concats to final.mp4 in workspace/promo-jobs/{jobId}/.
Create scripts/promo/validate-product-visual-assembler.ts — generates video from mock data, checks output MP4 exists, probes duration (45-65s), width=1080, height=1920.
